claim: In a profile of Jeffrey Epstein published October 28, 2002 in New York magazine — "Jeffrey Epstein: International Moneyman of Mystery," written by Landon Thomas Jr. — Donald Trump is quoted by name on Epstein: "I've known Jeff for fifteen years. Terrific guy. He's a lot of fun to be with. It is even said that he likes beautiful women as much as I do, and many of them are on the younger side." The profile was published six years before Epstein's 2008 Florida non-prosecution agreement and seventeen years before his 2019 federal indictment.

notes: The original nymag.com page is paywalled / blocked to headless browsers but is the canonical primary source; the quote is verbatim and independently reproduced across the press record (Newsweek, Yahoo, ABC) including in 2019 reporting following Epstein's indictment.
